hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Sump packer and seal assembly
function: The packer set below the interval before the screen is run, and the seal assembly on the screen tail that stabs into it to close the bottom of the pack.

tabs.overview: Set on wireline or tubing; gives a fixed depth reference for the screen.
tabs.safety: Set and depth-checked before the screen run.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
